text: Solhaven: ash falls like snow. A notice board calls for volunteers to investigate Black Stone Ruins.
Lady Airi Valen approaches you in the square. (Dialogue: D_AIRI_001)
A silent shrine. A candle burns without wind. (Dialogue: D_SHRINE_001)
The King's Road points toward the ash horizon and Diablo's destiny.
Black Stone Ruins: cracked runes glow crimson. (Dialogue: D_RUINS_001)
